title: Los Angeles Helicopter Tours

services.name: helicopter tours
services.desc: Any of our tour flights can be customized. We offer daytime and nighttime tours. For all current tour offerings, including our Malibu mountain top landing and Downtown LA landing tours, please click on the Book Online Now page below. We can custom tailor flights to our customers wishes and will accommodate any reasonable request, keeping your safety and comfort our top priority. Prior to boarding the helicopter, you will receive a safety briefing and meet the tour pilot to discuss your flight. Each passenger wears a headset to communicate with the pilot and other passengers. services.name: Charter Flights
services.desc: Our EXECUTIVE CHARTERS provide first class transportation by jet turbine helicopter to your preferred destination. Service to and from anywhere in Southern California including Santa Barbara, Palm Springs, San Diego, Las Vegas, Los Angeles, and Catalina Island. Helicopter choices are the six-seat Eurocopter AStar AS 350, or the five-seat five-seat Bell 206BIII JetRanger. Flat hourly rate, billed in 1/10 hour increments. All charter price quotes are round-trip and require a one-hour minimum. We can also arrange private turboprop and jet charters. Upon request, your limousine may pull up directly to the helicopter for quick and private boarding. Avoid traffic delays and crowded airport
